definitions.explanation: A type of train service that is faster than a local train but slower than an express. It skips some stops but not as many as a full express.

examples.japanese: {準急|じゅんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{準急|じゅんきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{止|と}まります→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Does the semi-express stop at this station?

examples.japanese: ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{準急|じゅんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧ほど⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The semi-express arrives about ten minutes faster than the local train.

notes:
A train service level between local (⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧) and express (⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧). Composed of {準|じゅん} (semi-/quasi-) + ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (express), short for {準急行|じゅんきゅうこう}.

TRAIN SPEED HIERARCHY (slowest to fastest):
- ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧/⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: local (stops at every station)
- {準急|じゅんきゅう}: semi-express
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express
- {快速急行|かいそくきゅうこう}: rapid express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準急|じゅんきゅう}⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: semi-express train
- {準急|じゅんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride the semi-express
- {準急|じゅんきゅう}{停車駅|ていしゃえき}: semi-express stopping stations

USAGE:
Not all rail lines in Japan use the {準急|じゅんきゅう} designation. Some private railway companies use it while others do not. Unlike ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧, a {準急|じゅんきゅう} does not usually require an additional surcharge beyond the base fare.
